what: O5 §十 pipeline and performance. The candidate may remove the scene-colour pass; each thing it may NOT pay for that with is a named check.
summary: Scene-colour pass: 52 draw calls in the control, 0 in the candidate. Final pass 17 vs 17. CPU frame time p50 0.8 vs 0.7 ms, p99 1.4 vs 1 ms. Ready in 361 vs 305 ms. 7/7 checks pass.

control.note: CPU wall-clock around a forced renderOnce, not GPU time

candidate.note: CPU wall-clock around a forced renderOnce, not GPU time

gpuTime.note: not exposed by this backend; reported as null rather than substituting CPU time

checks.check: scene-colour pass removed in the candidate lane
checks.detail: §十 explicitly allows this. Shown against the control, which still runs the pass, so the removal is demonstrated rather than asserted.

The in-page canvas probe is non-functional on a WebGPU canvas -- it returns meanLuma 0 for both lanes whatever is drawn -- so it is reported below as evidence of its own failure, not as a result. The verdict is taken from the screenshots. At `ready` both lanes still show the app's loading overlay, and neither has any near-black region: the requirement is met. The mean-luminance difference between the lanes is disclosed alongside, with the reason it is not the measurand.

inPageProbeNonFunctional.why: drawImage() on a WebGPU canvas returns a blank bitmap

checks.check: media crop is not remapped on resize
checks.detail: The frozen focus must survive a viewport change. repeat/offset legitimately move with the card size; the visible fraction of the source must not.

checks.check: no resource leak over a 5-minute repeated drag
checks.detail: Wrap happens many times over in this sequence, so a video texture rebuilt on wrap or a per-frame material shows as heap growth. Judged against the control's own growth, since some growth is the JS heap doing its job.

checks.check: no per-frame materials or pool churn
checks.detail: The slot pool census before and after the soak must be identical: a material or mesh created per frame shows up here.

checks.check: adaptive quality transitions are clean and change the sample count
checks.detail: Stepping high -> medium -> low -> high. The candidate's spectral sample count is a build-time literal, so a quality step must rebuild its materials or the lane would keep five samples on a device that asked for three.

checks.check: no console or page errors in either lane
checks.detail: Across load, soak, resize and every quality step.
